name: cineapp
description: CineApp is a movie-making machine controlled by voice. Let Claude hand it a job: make films, drive your apps, type for you, check your projects.
long_description:
CineApp is a movie-making machine controlled by voice — the filmmaking app and voice assistant in your Mac's menu bar. With this extension Claude can hand CineApp a job: check how a film project stands, look at its character, prop and location sheets, drive apps like After Effects, Premiere and Photoshop, type at the cursor, or tidy a folder.

CineApp has to be installed and running (get it at zxrstudios.com/cineapp). Claude can also see what's rendering, make the whole movie on one price card, and stop a render. Anything that costs credits stops at that price card on your Mac and waits for your own click — unless you turn on "Claude can approve spending" in CineApp Settings › Computer, which lets Claude press cards up to the limit you choose.
